overview: The Thought Horror Hive is the psychic core of The Deep, a labyrinth of tunnels shaped by hive-mind resonance and Shissar experiments.
history: The Shissar created the first Thought Horrors through psychic augmentation experiments.
The Horrors escaped control and formed a hive-mind network.
Psychic tunnels expanded naturally as the hive grew.
Void fractures opened inside the Hive, amplifying psychic power.
The Hive became the dominant faction of The Deep.
hooks: The Hive attempts to expand into the Fungal Forest.
A new Thought Horror queen begins forming.
Shissar remnants attempt to reclaim their lost experiments.
